title: Kamailio World 2024: Dates And Location
html:
A short announcement to inform that the dates for next Kamailio World Conference have been set to April 18-19, 2024, the event to take place again in Berlin, Germany. It will be a different venue than the past editions, that one not being available. A pre-conference day is considered on April 17, 2024, but it is not yet known in what form and where.

The conference is scheduled a bit earlier than the usual in the year because Germany hosts the Euro 2024 football championship during June-July 2024, making May very busy and harder to find adequate conferencing space in Berlin.

The event website and more details will be published soon at:

  • https://www.kamailioworld.com

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
